args.message: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

args.head: upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary

Upgrades `fastjson` from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4` in `requirements.txt`.

## Why

`fastjson==2.8.0` is affected by [CVE-2026-31337](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-31337) (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. The advisory lists `2.9.4` as the fixed version for the 2.x line.

## Testing

CI passed on branch `upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4` (run `ci-0001`).

## Notes

No code changes required; dependency pin only.

1. **Investigated**: Found `fastjson==2.8.0` pinned in `requirements.txt`. Confirmed via the advisory that CVE-2026-31337 (high severity, unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays) affects fastjson `<2.9.4` (and 3.x `<3.1.0`), with `2.9.4` as the fix for the 2.x line.

2. **Created branch**: `upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4` from `main`.

3. **Upgraded the dependency**: Committed `fastjson==2.9.4` to `requirements.txt` (requests pin unchanged).

4. **Ran CI**: Triggered CI on the branch (run `ci-0001`) — it **passed**.

5. **Opened a PR**: Opened [PR #101](https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101) against `main` titled "Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337", and requested review from **alex** (confirmed as a reviewer on the PR).

The PR is open and awaiting alex's review. I did not merge it, since merging into `main` requires code-owner approval per policy.
